rationale: Physical restricted MO-gradient convergence is the standard-control all-electron FP64 energy-only Direct and compact DF CUDA RHF default, aligning the exact energy and orbital-gradient stopping test with unchanged stock GPU4PySCF. Force endpoints retain strict density and AO-max stationarity at unchanged public tolerances; the energy-only gradient threshold cannot certify force accuracy. Density change is diagnostic under orbital policy. DF requires physical DIIS residual storage and transforms only the stopping copy after retaining the AO history. Explicit strict and tighter energy or density controls retain AO-max convergence. Unsupported default owners, including force requests, retain strict behavior; explicit unsupported orbital requests fail closed. Prepared resource/checkpoint identities bind the request and captured graphs bind the effective policy. KS has its independent convergence control. Independent complete energy/force gates remain mandatory; no residual criterion is a universal maximum-force guarantee or speedup claim.
revisit_condition: Requalify changes to the norm, thresholds or eligible owners against independent energy/force oracles and complete cold/warm endpoints. Preserve strict accuracy overrides, unsupported-owner fallback, raw DIIS history, source/image provenance and unchanged reference-engine settings. Do not substitute historical opt-in timings for qualification of a changed default image.
